Clarify C3_THRESHOLD_EXISTENCE: the significant Kruskal-Wallis threshold (T≈0.03–0.05) separates DEF-FORM-ONLY from other definitions, not task types. Fisher exact test on listing vs non-listing yields p=1.0 for any threshold in the definition gap.

validity_findings.finding: Spearman correlations (M4, M5) computed on definition-major ordered data (all DEF-FULL-MAP, then all DEF-FORM-ONLY, then all ISOLATED-A-LINK), creating artificial monotonic structure. Correct task-major ordering (preserving the 7×3 experimental design) yields rho≈-0.23 (canonical) and rho≈-0.21 (weighted), both non-significant (p>0.30) and below the 0.30 threshold.

NC1_SHUFFLED_RATIO control misimplemented. Producer's shuffle (randomizing canonical across all 21 pairs) preserves definition-driven weighted density structure, yielding mean shuffled eta^2≈0.37 > real eta^2=0.144. Correct null (permuting page_type labels) gives mean eta^2≈0.099, p=0.234 — task-type structure is not significant.

Ratio variation is primarily driven by definition choice (10× difference between DEF-FORM-ONLY mean R=0.0072 and DEF-FULL-MAP/ISOLATED-A-LINK mean R≈0.072), not task type (1.78× difference between detail and listing). The hypothesis that the ratio captures 'recipe sensitivity per task-definition pair' conflates definition artifacts with task-type effects.

C3_THRESHOLD_EXISTENCE passes only via Kruskal-Wallis on weighted density, which detects the definition-driven separation (DEF-FORM-ONLY weighted≈0.98 vs others weighted≈0.005–0.05). Fisher exact test on page-type composition (listing vs non-listing) yields p=1.0 for all thresholds in the definition gap, so the threshold does not classify by task type as the decision rule intends.

Small N=21 (7 tasks × 3 definitions, 1 site, truncated-first-20 sample) limits statistical power and generalizability. All 21 pairs used for both exploration and confirmation with no holdout. Results are bounded to the specific Magento site and element sample.

Canonical density denominator uses elements_with_bbox (total page elements with bounding boxes, ~1000–1500) while weighted density denominator uses sample total area (20 elements). This asymmetry affects absolute density values but cancels in the ratio. The weighted recipe uses area-weighting, not the role-based weighted sampling from prior experiments, so absolute densities are not directly comparable to parent experiments.

baseline_findings.finding: Confirmed: 2-recipe OECD/COINr dominance yields 0%/100% for all 21 pairs (from parent experiments). The ratio provides continuous discrimination (17× range), improving on the degenerate baseline.

Confirmed: Meta-analytic mean recipe (canonical+weighted)/2 always ranks between originals by mathematical identity, yielding 0 non-degenerate dominance. Ratio approach is structurally different (non-linear in densities).

Confirmed: Canonical densities range 0.0004–0.009 (all <0.01). Any binary threshold on canonical density alone flags all 21 pairs (zero specificity). Ratio provides meaningful classification by definition.

Weighted density alone separates definitions (form_only≈0.98 vs full_map≈0.02–0.05 vs iso_a≈0.005–0.02) but does not capture the relative recipe sensitivity (canonical/weighted relationship). The ratio adds task-type information (eta^2=0.144) that weighted density alone lacks (eta^2=0.000081).

claim_ceiling: The density ratio R = canonical_density / weighted_density varies 17× across 21 task-definition pairs (CV=0.70) and adds task-type information beyond weighted density alone (eta^2=0.144 vs 0.00008). However, the variation is predominantly driven by definition choice (10×), not task-type (1.78×). The ratio does not significantly correlate with canonical or weighted density (|Spearman|≈0.21–0.23, p>0.30), and task-type structure is not statistically significant (permutation p=0.23). The density ratio cannot serve as a principled MIXED outcome decision rule for recipe sensitivity in this setting. Maximum justified claim: 'The density ratio is a definition-sensitive continuous metric that correlates with the canonical/weighted density gap, but its task-type signal is weak and not statistically distinguishable from noise in this N=21 sample.'
